label: sec:borromean-reidemeister-intro
html: The Borromean rings 6^3_2, realized as the closure of the three-strand alternating word \mathcal{B}_3 = (\sigma_0\sigma_1^{-1})^3 \in B_3, form a Brunnian link: the three components are bound into a single topological composite, yet removing any one component leaves the remaining two unlinked. This section adopts \mathcal{B}_3 as the topological carrier of a three-quark baryon, introduces the flavour-typed crossing operator and its Gröbner–Shirshov normal form in H_3(q), proves invariance under all three Reidemeister moves, and demonstrates that single-component closures carry fermionic half-integer spin parity while two-component Hopf closures carry bosonic integer spin parity.
